description: Prepares a hostname that already serves a live website to move to Connect Your Domains with no downtime: proves the domain's owner chose it and lets the TLS certificate be issued before any traffic moves. Never changes where the hostname points; never touches MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC or any other record.
variableDescription: %token%: a random per-hostname ownership token, 32 lowercase letters and digits. %cfprevalidate%: the Cloudflare for SaaS ownership_verification value for this hostname, a UUID that Cloudflare prescribes in full.
